newsitem.title: GERMANY: WARNING -- ONLY EAT YOUR PIZZA IF IT'S HOT.
newsitem.headline: WARNING -- ONLY EAT YOUR PIZZA IF IT'S HOT.

text.p: Think twice before you order a home-delivered pizza, even if your fridge is empty and you're too tired to cook -- the Hamburg Institute for Hygiene says a third of home-delivered food fails hygiene tests.

The Institute said on Wednesday tests carried out on 74 pizzas and other home-delivered meals showed one-third did not meet hygiene requirements, well below the accepted level of failure for restaurants and canteens.
In spot tests the Institute found no germs in the food, but it said problems with hygiene and cooking techniques could encourage germs. It warned -- hot food should arrive hot.
